sources.title: mlx-community/flux-3-image-klein-bf16 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model expects a full scene caption (medium, scene, lighting, each subject's colours, materials and position). Run a prompt upsampler first: BFL's Apache-2.0 flux-3-image-klein-pup, or any LLM given its system_prompts.json.

sources.title: GitHub - black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein: FLUX 3 Image Klein ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains the reference inference code for FLUX 3 Image Klein, the 5.6B open weights image model from Black Forest Labs: text-to-image, editing with up to 10 reference images, and layout control with bounding boxes, through one model. It ships with a prompt upsampler; do not use the model without it.

sources.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein: open weights, 5.6B parameters
sources.snippet: In internal evaluations, FLUX 3 Image Klein ranks first in text-to-image, multi-reference generation and image editing, ahead of larger open weights models. It also rates above the closed models in the comparison, Ideogram V4.5 and FLUX.2 [pro].
